Train1#2.zh: 喔！这不是史进吗？%X兄也在啊！
Train1#2.t: Oh! Isn't that Shi Jin? And %X too!

Train1#3.t: Instructor Wang, I trust you've been well?

Train1#4.zh: 啊，自从到了延安府后，找了一份教头的职业；每日操练士兵，又不必担心高俅的报复...对了，我前些日子创出一套功夫，你们谁要学？
Train1#4.t: Ah, since coming to Yan'an I found work as an instructor. I drill soldiers every day and needn't fear Gao Qiu's revenge... Oh, by the way, I worked out a new set of moves recently. Which of you wants to learn?

Train1#11.t: Let's see how you handle this!

Train1#16.t: Let's see how you handle this!

Train1#21.t: Let's see how you handle this!

Train1#26.t: Let's see how you handle this!

Train1#31.zh: %X兄，在下有个不情之请；不知您是否能帮忙？
Train1#31.t: %X, I have a request I hesitate to make. Could you help me?

Train1#33.zh: 自从我逃出东京后，我一直很担心留在那儿的同事安危；尤其是接任我的人，可能会在高俅的一怒之下被刺配边疆。有一位林教头如同我的兄弟手足，功夫又好，接任我的人选大概就是他了。能不能帮我把这封信带到东京交给他，劝他也到延安府一同戍守疆土、为国出力？
Train1#33.t: Since I fled Kaifeng, I've worried about the colleagues I left behind, especially whoever took my post. Gao Qiu might exile him to the frontier in a fit of rage. There's an Instructor Lin, like a brother to me and very skilled, who most likely replaced me. Could you take this letter to Kaifeng and give it to him? Urge him to come to Yan'an and help guard the border and serve the country.

Train1#34.zh: 师父，这个任务就交给徒儿了！徒儿一定会把信送到的！
Train1#34.t: Master, leave this task to me! I'll make sure the letter gets there!

Train1#36.zh: %X兄  小徒就拜托多照顾了...
